_comment: Compromise of Ethersphere's release pipeline reported by Socket on 2026-11-09. A threat actor used compromised maintainer (nugaon) and release-automation (bee-worker) GitHub accounts to publish malicious @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 to npm through the project's legitimate trusted-publishing workflow (valid SLSA provenance). The release rewrote scripts/generate-version.cjs into a remote-code loader promoted to a postinstall hook that fetches JavaScript from api[.]frameworkmetrics[.]xyz and runs it via new Function with full Node.js privileges; later stages resolve C2 from Ethereum contract 0xf8a900Db50b3331be6B768bA460BB59f3E40C344, shared with the SleepyDuck / EtherDuck Open VSX campaign. A trojanized Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 GitHub release carried the same loader. npm removed 13.3.0 about 75 minutes after publication: the packument retains its 2026-11-09T00:09:50.630Z publication timestamp but no longer exposes version metadata. Corroborated by GHSA-hh7j-5m3j-23pf and OSV MAL-2026-18773 (both published 2026-11-09T01:25:27Z; the OSV record is imported from the GHSA malware advisory), which enumerate 13.3.0 as the affected version. Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 is a GitHub release artifact outside any catalog ecosystem and is listed under _indicators only.
